question: Why did Paul leave Titus behind on Crete?
choices: To set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders
explanation: Paul left Titus in Crete to set things in order and appoint elders in every city.

question: What family trait is mentioned for an elder?
choices: He must have faithful children not accused of rebellion
explanation: Paul says an elder should have faithful children not accused of riot or unruly behavior.

question: Which quality is required of a bishop?
explanation: A bishop is to be hospitable, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, and temperate.

question: What must an elder hold fast?
choices: The faithful word as he has been taught
explanation: He must hold firmly to the faithful word so he can exhort and convince gainsayers.

question: What is Titus told to speak?
explanation: Paul tells Titus to speak the things that fit sound doctrine.

question: What are older men to be?
choices: Sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, love, and patience
explanation: Older men are called to mature, steady character and soundness in faith, love, and patience.

question: What are older women to teach the younger women?
choices: To love their husbands and love their children
explanation: Older women are to teach what is good so younger women love their husbands and children.

question: What does Paul tell Titus to show himself as?
explanation: Titus is to model good works, purity in doctrine, gravity, and sincerity.

question: What does the grace of God teach believers to do?
choices: Deny ungodliness and worldly lusts and live soberly, righteously, and godly
explanation: Grace trains believers to reject ungodliness and live godly lives in this present world.

question: How are believers told to respond to rulers and authorities?
choices: Be subject and ready to every good work
explanation: Paul tells believers to be subject to rulers and ready for every good work.

question: To whom should believers show all meekness?
explanation: Believers are to speak evil of no one and show all meekness unto all men.

question: What does Paul say saved us?
explanation: Paul says God saved us not by works of righteousness, but according to His mercy.

question: After how many warnings is a divisive man to be rejected?
choices: After the first and second admonition
explanation: Paul says a divisive person is to be rejected after the first and second admonition.

question: Where did Paul leave Titus?
explanation: Paul says, For this cause left I thee in Crete.

question: What does Paul call himself in the greeting?
choices: A servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ
explanation: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ.

question: How does Paul address Titus?
choices: Mine own son after the common faith
explanation: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith.

question: What does Paul say God cannot do?
explanation: God, that cannot lie, promised eternal life before the world began.

question: What was Titus to ordain in every city?
explanation: Titus was to ordain elders in every city, as Paul had appointed him.

question: A bishop must be blameless as what?
explanation: A bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God.

question: What must be done to the mouths of the unruly and vain talkers?
choices: They must be answered in the synagogue
They must be heard with patience
They must be taught the law
explanation: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses.

question: Why did the false teachers subvert whole houses?
explanation: They teach things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

question: Who said the Cretians are always liars?
explanation: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said so.

question: Which group does Paul say are specially unruly and vain talkers?
explanation: There are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision.

question: How was Titus to rebuke the Cretians?
explanation: Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith.

question: To what must Titus not give heed?
choices: Jewish fables and commandments of men
explanation: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

question: What must an elder be, besides blameless, with regard to marriage?
explanation: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife.

question: What must an elder be able to do by sound doctrine?
explanation: He must hold fast the faithful word, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

question: What three things did the Cretian prophet call his people?
explanation: The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

question: What does Paul say of the prophet's saying about the Cretians?
explanation: Paul says, This witness is true.

question: What is defiled in them that are defiled and unbelieving?
explanation: Even their mind and conscience is defiled.

question: How do they who profess to know God deny him?
explanation: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him.

question: In hope of what did God promise before the world began?
explanation: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began.

question: How has God manifested his word in due times?
explanation: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching.

question: Who are to teach the young women?
explanation: The aged women are to teach the young women.

question: How are servants to be toward their own masters?
explanation: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters.

question: Who gave himself for us?
explanation: Looking for the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ; who gave himself for us.

question: How are young men to be exhorted?
explanation: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

question: What must servants not do to their masters?
explanation: Servants are told not to purloin, but to show all good fidelity.

question: Why are servants to show good fidelity?
choices: That they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour
explanation: That they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

question: Why are young women to be discreet and obedient to their husbands?
choices: That the word of God be not blasphemed
explanation: Chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

question: What has appeared to all men?
choices: The grace of God that bringeth salvation
explanation: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men.

question: What blessed hope are believers looking for?
choices: The glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour
explanation: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ.

question: From what did Christ give himself to redeem us?
explanation: He gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity.

question: How are the aged women to be in behaviour?
explanation: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness.

question: What must aged women not be given to?
explanation: The aged women are not false accusers, not given to much wine.

question: Where are young women to be keepers?
explanation: Young women are to be discreet, chaste, keepers at home.

question: What kind of people does Christ purify to himself?
choices: A peculiar people zealous of good works
explanation: He might purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

question: What does Paul tell Titus so that no man will despise him?
choices: Speak, exhort, and rebuke with all authority
Wear the dress of an elder
explanation: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

question: In what are aged men to be sound?
explanation: The aged men are to be sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

question: Why must Titus show sound speech that cannot be condemned?
choices: So the opponent will be ashamed with nothing evil to say
explanation: That he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

question: Which three does Paul name for Titus's doctrine?
explanation: In doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity.

question: How should we live in this present world?
explanation: We should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world.

question: What are believers told to speak of no man?
explanation: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers.

question: Where had Paul determined to winter?
explanation: Come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

question: Who is called a lawyer in this chapter?
explanation: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently.

question: By what are we justified?
explanation: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs.

question: Of what are believers made heirs?
explanation: We should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

question: How did Paul say we ourselves once lived?
explanation: Living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

question: What appeared toward man?
choices: The kindness and love of God our Saviour
explanation: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared.

question: What does Paul say believers should avoid?
choices: Foolish questions, genealogies and strivings about the law
explanation: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law.

question: What is true of the heretic who will not heed admonition?
choices: He is forgiven after a season
He is subverted, sins, and is condemned of himself
He is judged by the church
explanation: Such an one is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

question: Why does Paul want Titus to affirm these things constantly?
choices: That believers be careful to maintain good works
That the church may grow in number
explanation: That they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works.

question: Whom should Titus greet?
choices: Them that love us in the faith
explanation: Greet them that love us in the faith.

question: How does Paul describe these good works?
explanation: These things are good and profitable unto men.

question: Which two men might Paul send to Titus?
explanation: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus.

question: Why does Paul say to avoid foolish questions and genealogies?
choices: They are forbidden by the law
explanation: For they are unprofitable and vain.

question: What did God shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ?
explanation: Renewing of the Holy Ghost; which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour.

question: Which three words describe what we ourselves once were?
explanation: We ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived.

question: Why are believers to learn to maintain good works?
choices: For necessary uses, that they not be unfruitful
explanation: Let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

question: What were we serving in our past?
explanation: Serving divers lusts and pleasures.

question: What are believers to be instead of brawlers?
explanation: To be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

question: Who sends greetings to Titus?
explanation: All that are with me salute thee.
